methods.description: Distinguish positive whole-number perfect-square roots from nonsquare roots; source-controlled signed/multiplied/additive examples classified without introducing surd manipulations.
Apply fraction-of-integers definition and distinguish recurring decimals from nonrecurring irrational decimals; infinity alone is insufficient.
